Case study, NDA

Warehouse monitoring where operators see status before numbers

Role: Product DesignerPlatform: web appScope: UX strategy, IA, UI, prototypingStatus: in use by operators

A web app that operators use to supervise automated device fulfillment for a US telecom company. I designed the structure and the screens. Operators see the state of every job and machine first. They open the details only when they need them.

Inside: the dashboard, the path from a job to its equipment, the rack queue and exception handling, with the reason for each decision.

  • 3levels: dashboard, job, equipment
